KADI, India
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a motivated Software Development Intern to join our tech team. You will work on real projects, collaborate with developers, and gain hands\-on experience in software development.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Assist in developing and testing software features
* Work with the development team on live projects
* Write clean, maintainable code
* Participate in code reviews and daily stand\-ups
* Document technical work


**Requirements**
* Currently pursuing B.Tech / BCA / MCA or equivalent
* Basic knowledge of any programming language (Python, Java, JavaScript)
* Eagerness to learn and take ownership
* Good problem\-solving skills


 What We Offer
   

  

* Internship certificate
* Letter of recommendation
* Hands\-on project experience
* Flexible working hours
* Stipend (performance based)
